global.description: Global settings applied to all sub-charts

cni.description: Istio installed with the istio-cni plugin (default true). true: profile namespaces enforce Pod Security Standards baseline. false: classic istio-init sidecars, no PSS label.

mode.description: Model Registry topology — single switch for kubeflow-hub and user-namespace. perProfile (default, upstream parity): one UI/BFF/catalog/controller/CSI in kubeflow, a registry server + Postgres per profile namespace. shared: DEPRECATED, will be removed in a future release — legacy single registry in kubeflow on KFP's MariaDB.

storageClass.description: Default StorageClass for all PVCs. Empty = cluster default.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy applied to all components

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secrets applied to every Deployment/StatefulSet

imageRegistry.description: Optional private registry prefix. When set, prepended to all image refs. E.g. 'my-registry.corp.com/kubeflow'

gatewayAuthMode.description: Ingress-gateway authentication mode. 'native' (default): upstream-parity Istio-native ext_authz — istiod MeshConfig extensionProvider + CUSTOM AuthorizationPolicy + dex-jwt RequestAuthentication + require-jwt DENY. Requires the 'oauth2-proxy' extensionProvider in istiod MeshConfig (runMe.sh adds it by default; native-authz-guard fails the install fast if missing). 'envoyfilter': self-contained hand-written EnvoyFilter ext_authz chain, no istiod MeshConfig change (for BYO-istio); opt in with -f values-envoyfilter-authz.yaml or runMe.sh --legacy-authz.

istio.description: Istio ingress-gateway identity — single source of truth consumed by kubeflow-istio-resources, kubeflow-hub, user-namespace, and knative-serving.

principal.description: ServiceAccount principal of the ingress gateway used by AuthorizationPolicy source.principals. Rancher/AppCo Istio: 'cluster.local/ns/istio-system/sa/istio'; upstream: '.../sa/istio-ingressgateway-service-account'.

selector.description: Workload label selector of the ingress-gateway pods, shared by the Gateway CRs, the authn EnvoyFilter workloadSelector, and the native auth CRs. Must be non-empty: an empty selector on the istio-system auth resources (context: GATEWAY) would attach the auth chain to every gateway in the mesh. Rancher: {istio: istio}; upstream: {istio: ingressgateway}.

name.description: Istio Gateway (<namespace>/<name>) for the Kubeflow dashboard and app VirtualServices. KServe inference uses global.kserve.gateway.name.

hostname.description: Dashboard host (global.gateway.hostname). Leave empty ('') for wildcard/IP+NodePort access, or set a hostname: a dotted FQDN (kubeflow.example.com), a single-label name (kubeflow, localhost), or an IPv4 literal (10.43.1.7) are all accepted. Must not contain '*' — a literal wildcard hostname would make the auth-bypass filter trust every host. A bare public suffix (a single-label registry TLD such as 'com'/'io'/'co.uk') is ALSO rejected: hostname is seeded into the letsEncrypt ClusterIssuer's DNS-01 dnsZones (letsencrypt-ClusterIssuer.yaml), so 'com' would scope the ACME solver to the entire TLD — exactly what that template's comment warns against. The list is the common gTLD/ccTLD set, not the full Public Suffix List; the ClusterIssuer comment remains the backstop for the rest. The DNS charset is enforced (no whitespace/non-breaking-space/embedded-newline/trailing-dot/'_'/leading-'-'): the hostname is embedded verbatim into the authn EnvoyFilter's Lua, and an invalid character makes LuaJIT reject the inline_code so istiod NACKs the filter and the gateway falls open. Rejecting it here fails the install instead. Independent of TLS. Kept in sync with the kubeflow-istio-resources values.schema.json.

externalDNS.description: Annotate kubeflow-gateway so an external-dns (bundled or existing) publishes a record for hostname. No effect without hostname.

source.description: Gateway TLS: '' plain HTTP; selfSigned / letsEncrypt (issuers created by the chart); issuerRef (your issuer); secret (your Secret); edge (TLS terminated in front of the gateway: plain HTTP, no redirect, Secure cookies, https URLs).

secretName.description: TLS Secret in istio-system: written by the chart's Certificate (selfSigned, letsEncrypt, issuerRef) or yours (secret).

httpsRedirect.description: Redirect the dashboard host's :80 to :443 (gateway TLS sources; never with edge).

email.description: Optional ACME account email for expiry notices.

solver.description: cloudflare (DNS-01, needs cloudflare) or http01 (no wildcards).

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare DNS-01 solver; the token Secret must be in cert-manager's namespace.

letsEncrypt.description: Let's Encrypt (source letsEncrypt); the chart creates the kubeflow-letsencrypt ClusterIssuer.

domain.description: Base domain for KServe InferenceServices. Prefer a scoped subdomain (e.g. 'models.example.com') over a bare org-wide domain: with externalHttps the cert is a '*.<domain>' wildcard. Pushed to the knative-serving and kserve subcharts. Empty = their chart-local knativeServing.domain / kserve.ingressDomain (example.com). Must not include a leading '*.'.

externalHttps.description: Inference over HTTPS on the dedicated inference gateway: a '*.<domain>' wildcard cert on :443, route hosts flattened to '{name}-{namespace}.<domain>'. Needs domain, a gateway hostname and a gateway TLS source (not edge).

name.description: Dedicated inference gateway (<namespace>/<name>), shared by kubeflow-istio-resources (the Gateway), knative-serving (config-istio) and kserve (inferenceservice-config).

enabled.description: Render the inference gateway. false only when neither KServe nor Knative Serving is installed.

secretName.description: Wildcard TLS Secret in istio-system. '' = kserve-wildcard-tls (issued by cert-manager); required with tls.source secret.

email.description: Default Dex login email (DEMO DEFAULT — change in production)

passwordHash.description: bcrypt hash of the initial Dex user's password; "" generates a password on first install

enabled.description: Enable NetworkPolicies (deny-by-default + explicit allows). Requires a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy.

kubeDnsCidr.description: CIDR for kube-dns DNS egress allow rule

install.description: Install cert-manager via this chart (not recommended; install separately)

domain.description: Knative Serving domain for InferenceService external URLs. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserve.domain. Only set for a standalone knative-serving install without the umbrella globals.

domainTemplate.description: Go template for the Knative route host. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserve.externalHttps: empty uses Knative's upstream dotted form '{{ .Name }}.{{ .Namespace }}.{{ .Domain }}', and when external HTTPS is enabled the chart applies the flattened single-label form '{{ .Name }}-{{ .Namespace }}.{{ .Domain }}' so a single wildcard cert (*.<domain>) can cover inference hosts. Knative/KServe render this with Go's stdlib text/template (no Sprig), so the namespace cannot be hashed — name and namespace are joined by '-', which means two different (name, namespace) pairs can collide into the same host (see the README cross-tenant naming caveat). Set explicitly only to override; the flattened label must stay under 63 characters. Note '.Name' is the Knative Service name, so a serverless InferenceService component already carries its suffix here — a predictor renders as '{isvc}-predictor-{namespace}' (likewise '-transformer'/'-explainer'), so budget ~10 chars for that suffix against the 63-char limit.

retentionDays.description: Delete objects under private-artifacts/ older than N days; -1 keeps them.

ingressDomain.description: Domain for InferenceService external URLs. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserve.domain. Only set for a standalone kserve install without the umbrella globals.

urlScheme.description: Scheme KServe reports in status.url. Normally left unset — auto-derived from global.kserve.externalHttps (https when enabled, otherwise http). Only set for a standalone kserve install without the umbrella globals.

name.description: Example profile and namespace name (default kubeflow-user-example-com).

modelRegistry.description: Per-profile Model Registry data plane (registry server, Postgres and Istio routing/policy in each profile namespace); follows global.modelRegistry.mode. Settings are documented in charts/user-namespace/values.yaml.

enabled.description: null (default) follows global.modelRegistry.mode; true/false overrides it.

extraNamespaces.description: Existing profile namespaces created outside the chart that also get a registry (registry resources only).

existingSecret.description: Use this pre-created Secret (keys POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD, in every registry namespace) instead of a generated one. Set it when rendering with helm template (no lookup).

sslMode.description: libpq sslmode for the external Postgres. verify-ca / verify-full are not offered: the chart cannot mount a CA bundle, so they would fail at startup.

sources.description: YAML string of catalog source definitions

db.description: Database connection settings (uses KFP's mysql-secret by default)

trainer.description: Kubeflow Trainer V2 — TrainJob CRD + controller

installCRDs.description: Install JobSet CRDs. Set false if JobSet is already installed.

enabled.description: Deploy the jobset-controller-manager alongside the trainer.

istioResources.description: kubeflow-istio-resources sub-chart (Gateways, VirtualServices, AuthorizationPolicies). Requires Istio CRDs.

externalAuth.description: true: an auth layer this chart doesn't manage protects the gateway and sets kubeflow-userid, so global.oauth2Proxy.enabled=false is allowed.

admissionWebhook.description: PodDefaults admission webhook. Requires cert-manager CRDs.

userNamespace.description: user-namespace sub-chart (default Profile + additionalUsers). Requires profiles.enabled=true.

kubeflow-istio-resources.description: kubeflow-istio-resources sub-chart overrides (gateway.annotations, gateway.port). Hostname, TLS and KServe exposure are global.gateway / global.tls / global.kserve.

externaldns.description: The bundled external-dns sub-chart (alias externaldns). Other external-dns chart settings pass through unchecked.

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled external-dns. For the gateway's hostname record also set global.gateway.externalDNS.

name.description: DNS provider name (cloudflare, aws, azure, google, etc.)

domainFilters.description: Limit DNS management to these domains (recommended)

txtOwnerId.description: Unique TXT record owner ID — prevents conflicts in shared clusters

apiToken.description: Cloudflare API token. The chart stores it in the cloudflare-api-token Secret, which the default env passes to external-dns as CF_API_TOKEN.

env.description: Provider credentials as env vars. Replaces the default (CF_API_TOKEN from cloudflare-api-token); keep a CF_API_TOKEN entry when cloudflare.apiToken is set.

externalSecrets.description: Copy registry pull secrets into Profile namespaces (and extraNamespaces) with the External Secrets Operator. Unknown keys are rejected, so typos fail the install.

enabled.description: Render the ClusterSecretStore and ClusterExternalSecrets (needs the External Secrets Operator API).

sourceNamespace.description: Namespace holding the source pull secrets.

secrets.description: Pull secrets to copy, by name.

namespaceSelector.description: Label selector for target namespaces; empty or null = only extraNamespaces.

matchLabels.description: Set a label to null to drop it from the chart default.

extraNamespaces.description: Also copy the pull secrets into these namespaces, by name.

refreshInterval.description: How often ESO re-syncs the copies (Go duration, e.g. 1h).
